source_units.text: Compose an oath for an invented civic ceremony.
The intended readers are participants taking part in the invented city ceremony.
I want a solemn and inclusive tone.
Use at least 55 words and no more than 85 words in total.
Include the following invented details: The oath centers the common table, promises to listen before speaking, and pledges to leave a place for someone not yet present.
Do not attach the oath to a real institution.
Preserve these exact phrases: "the common table", "listen before speaking", "leave a place".
